Episode 159. Martial Emperor Tournament (6)
The two who fought in the shocking 22nd round had been unconscious for over a week.

During that time, Tushin Ban had stopped the Martial Emperor Tournament. Originally, the Martial Emperor Tournament would continue immediately even if an 'accident' occurred, but this time was special.
That's because Jin was the only hope that could send the Myung Wang clan to the outside. His death meant the halt of the Myung Wang clan's history.
"Otowang brothers!"
"How are they doing, are the brothers okay!?"
"Brothers? Hey, Paltuwang brothers! Didn't you see? What Jin did to the Shiptuwang brothers after the match was decided...!"
"The Shiptuwang brothers treated Jin like an enemy first. It's not that what Jin did was right, but the Shiptuwang brothers wouldn't have had to go that far."
"So he stabbed the unsuspecting brother in the chest and exploded psychic energy inside him? This is not an accident but an attempted murder."
"Brothers, shut up for a moment! Let's listen to the Otowang brothers!"
Boras had a pale face due to the major surgery that had been ongoing for over a week.
"......Both are safe. They will not have any disabilities and there is no danger to their lives. However, they need extreme rest, so do not come until I say they are okay."
The Myung Wang clans nodded their heads.
Boras separated the two men's sickrooms in case of any possible situation, and the Myung Wang clans took their places in front of the sickroom of the person they supported.
Even before the 22nd round, the Myung Wang clans were divided and seemed to fight every day.
However, if the factions were almost evenly divided before, now there were overwhelmingly many people supporting Kaiyo.
They had no choice. It is true that Kaiyo acted as if he couldn't acknowledge Jin first, but he didn't cross the line.
Jin clearly crossed the line. Moreover, strictly speaking, Kaiyo was just following the tradition and principle of the Martial Emperor Tournament.
Before Jin's provocation, Kaiyo had never directly attacked Jin first.
The Martial Emperors protecting Jin's sickroom were only Linfa, Beliz, and Garmund.
Including Shak, there weren't even ten common warriors, which well reflected the hearts of most of the Myung Wang clans.
However, even those who gathered on Jin's side were not unconditionally supporting him.
They too thought that Jin had committed a major crime.

Still, they were of the position that he should not be expelled from the 'brotherhood'. The rest of the brothers mostly held the position that Jin should be expelled, or not only expelled but also severely punished.
"Damn, how did this happen...."
Garmund said, touching his forehead.
He felt the most responsibility for this incident.
"If I had fought properly, I don't think the situation would have worsened like this."
"Stop blaming yourself... Brother Garmund. It's not... your fault."
"Right, instead of spending time on that, let's think about a solution. Huh, is this all there is to our brothers' bond? We're no different from the foolish other races we despised in the past."
Those who wanted to expel Jin, and those who didn't.
Actually, there was no choice. The absolute decision power of the Myeongwang Tribe lies only with Tushin Ban.
Ban only paused the Tuwangdaejun, but still did not express any other opinion.
Not only that, he isolated himself and did not meet anyone.
"Tushin brother should say something."
"It's the first time Tushin brother has been quiet in such a situation. I wonder what he's thinking."
While the worries and anger of the Myeongwang tribe grew, Jin and Kaio regained consciousness only two days later.
When Jin woke up, he immediately made his position clear to the brothers who rushed to him with Boras's permission.
"If Tushin brother doesn't directly punish, I will continue to participate in the Tuwangdaejun as planned. If necessary, I will stick to the same method that I used to beat Brother Kaio."
It was shocking for the waiting brothers.
They naturally expected Jin to reflect on his excessive actions and apologize to the enraged brothers.
"Brother Jin, are you crazy? Will you do that again?"
At the furious voice of Belliz, Jin nodded quietly.
"Yes. The fundamental of Tuwangdaejun is not a duel but a fight, Brother Chiltuwang. And I will prove my will and qualification to succeed in this fight."
"So, it's okay to do that for victory? Do you really think it's a fair competition to win by trampling on the faith and affection of your brothers?"
"I can do more than that. If you think it's unfair, the brothers who fight with me can do the same."

"...Unlike Brother Jin, Brother Shiptuwang has suffered a severe injury that he cannot continue the Tuwangdaejun. The blast in his chest from Brother Jin! It will take at least a year to fully recover. He can't even eat on his own now! Don't you feel anything?"
"And I almost lost both my eyes to Brother Shiptuwang. At the end, my head almost disappeared."
"But that didn't happen. Why do you think that is? Because Brother Shiptuwang couldn't shoot Brother Jin in the end."

"Right. I'm not sure if he really couldn't shoot in the end. Anyway, Brother Shiptuwang lost, and I will win in the next match. Can't kill a brother? The problem is that you're going into a match where accidents are said to be unavoidable with such a defeated mentality."
"What did you say...?"
"And do you think the Twelfth King brother couldn't shoot me because he genuinely cared about me? Probably because without me, the hope of you brothers going outside would disappear."
Belriz raised his arm as if to slap Jin's cheek.
But then, he trembled and lowered his arm.

"I would appreciate it if you brothers would be honest about your attitude towards me. If you truly accept me as a brother, you should not have denied that I am Sigmund's successor, now that another possibility has arisen."
"Not all of the brothers did that."

"But many of them did. Even the Tosin brothers did not stop that atmosphere. And what is the result? The brothers are already divided, and most of them support Kaiyo. In a way, it's not even division. I have the impression that it's closer to unity since the opportunity to deny my inheritance, which they didn't like from the beginning, has come."
At Jin's malicious words, all the brothers around him clenched their teeth. They wondered if this was the same Jin they had been seeing all along.
"...I think we may have misjudged Brother Jin."
"I've never truly belonged to the 'we' of the Myungwang tribe. Now even you will turn around and stand on the other side. After all, arms bend inward."
When Belriz turned around and left the sickroom, the warriors followed him. Linpa and Garmonde stayed for a moment, looking down at Jin.
"Brother Jin... why are you doing this..."

"Brother Jin! No matter what, this isn't right. It started from my fault, but now it's definitely you who's wrong, Jin! The Twelfth King brother was a bit rough, but don't you think it's not just because he wanted to go outside that he couldn't shoot you?"
"Please leave."
Jin closed his eyes, and the two stood quietly for a while.
"...Brother Jin, just know this... If you keep doing this, all the brothers might really... turn their backs."
Meanwhile, the atmosphere in Kaiyo's sickroom was even heavier.
Everyone was silently suppressing their anger. If the neural explosion had occurred in a slightly more dangerous position, Kaiyo's heart would have shattered, leaving him crippled.
"He should be expelled."
"Yes! That guy, Jin. I don't even want to call him a brother now. He crossed the line. This is clearly attempted fratricide."
"If we expel him, we will never be able to leave, but we can't just let it go."
Kaiyo silently swallowed the porridge fed to him by Gutu King Baba.
"The Tosin brothers just issued a command!"
Mouka, who had just entered the sickroom, shouted.
"What did they say!?"
"They said that as soon as Brother Jin fully recovers, they will proceed with the King's Competition."
Sighs echoed from all around.
Of course, they expected Jin to be disciplined, but it was not easy to accept when it was announced that the King's Competition would proceed.
The continuation of the King's Competition implied nothing less than excluding Kaiyo.
Because Kaiyo was now unable to participate in this King's Competition.
"…It's now certain. The Tosin brothers have no intention of directly disciplining Jin."
However, the Myungwang tribe did not think this was favoritism.
Rather, they believed they were given a 'choice.' About what to do with Jin. Or, they thought it was giving Jin another chance.
To see how he behaves in the next competition, how he treats his brothers.
"The Tosin brothers must feel the same. Even if it means we can't go out, we can't just let it slide."
"Right. If they had no intention of punishing Jin, they would have ordered us never to take revenge."
"Jin does not qualify to succeed the Tosin. Not only is he lacking in power, but he has even tried to kill the Twelfth King brother, exploiting our weakness that if Jin dies, we can't go outside."
"When it's my turn, I will... in place of the Twelfth King brother..."
When several members of the Myungwang tribe expressed their will to fight, Baba put down the porridge.
"But in the end, Jin didn't kill the Twelfth King brother. Everyone, just calm down a bit."
"Brother Gutu King. Are you saying we need to think more?"
"When Brother Paltu King messed up, the reason why the Twelfth King brother got so angry was because of Brother Gutu King. You must know that."
Gutu King Baba.
Until their extinction, most of the Myungwang tribe thought that the person who would eventually succeed the Tosin would be Baba.
Including Kaiyo, the Kings fought their whole lives to surpass her.
Even in the last King's Competition held before their extinction, the final winner was Baba.
"Ha, I know. I know. But are you really going to kill Jin? It could be a mistake. And even though everyone talks like that, in reality, none of you have the courage to exile or kill Jin."
"Baba…"
Finally, Kaiyo lifted his head with a hoarse voice, and everyone looked at him.
Kaiyo, with his eyes wide open, said this.
"If… Jin makes another mistake. Then… you should… end it yourself."
